digest.component_or_area: coordinator and adapter contract removal validation
propositions: End-to-end portable credential-free Cloud/DC test suite must cover mixed success, transient recovery, long-delay deferral, permanent failure, auth/provider stop, fuse open/reset, label-first create, restart, partial outcome, and delivery failure scenarios.
Route census and poison checks must verify no reachable removed fallback path exists after contract removal.
ADR 0103 must document retry ownership, failure taxonomy, fuse behavior, containment strategy, intentional deltas, expand/contract cutover, and rollback that never deletes successful remote work.
Rollback mechanism must re-observe remote state and guarantee no deletion of successful Jira work.
All portable tests must run without external credentials or CI-provider-specific triggers in every supported environment.
Architecture and operator documentation must define versioned coordinator/adapter dependency direction, output contracts, and future adapter atomic-operation and retry obligations.
